author: New China TV
description: Discover the grasslands of Uxin Banner in Ordos, where visitors can ride with the wind, gallop across vast open landscapes, and watch herds of cattle and sheep roam freely under blue skies and drifting clouds. Far from the hustle and bustle of the city, the grasslands offer a refreshing sense of freedom and joy.
title: Charm Unveiled | Meet Uxin, Embrace the Romance of the Grasslands

author: New China TV
description:
One rescue. One unexpected little guest.
Firefighters rescued a couple trapped in a car after a crash in China's Yunnan. Both parents needed hospital treatment, but their daughter needed someone to look after her. The crew still had one more person to care for...
#Heartwarming #PositiveVibes #EverydayHeroes #FeelGoodStories
title: Firefighters care for girl after rescuing her parents

author: New China TV
description: The Red Army crossed the Chishui River four times, repeatedly changing direction and outmaneuvering a much larger pursuing force. It stands as one of the most decisive and victorious military moves during the #LongMarch. Join Xinhua's Zhou Xuanni to visit key historic sites along the Chishui River in southwest China's Guizhou. (recorded)
title: Long March memories: Tracing Red Army's footsteps along China's Chishui River

author: New China TV
description:
Saudi Arabia said Friday that three people were killed and several others injured in attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport the previous day.
The Houthi group has warned international airlines against using Saudi airspace, calling it a military operations zone.
Analysts warn that continued military escalation could fuel further retaliation, putting more civilians and critical infrastructure at risk.
title: Riyadh airport attacks kill three as cross-border strikes continue

author: New China TV
description:
The cotton harvest is in full swing in Shawan, Xinjiang! Join Xinhua live for a close-up look at the harvest in this major cotton-producing area in northern Xinjiang.
Shawan planted 1,645,700 mu (about 109,700 hectares) of cotton in 2026, according to it's agriculture and rural affairs bureau. Its cotton production has an overall mechanization rate of over 99 percent, with machinery used throughout the process, from sowing and field management to harvesting. (Recorded)
title: LIVE: A close-up look at the cotton harvest in Xinjiang
